learning_outcomes.text: Know the classification & designation of iron-based materials and understand the influence of alloying elements on the properties of steels and cast iron.
Be able to derive application-specific heat treatments for steels depending on alloying elements.
Connect alloying and processing routes (casting, wrought, additive manufacturing) as well as heat treatments for aluminum with expected changes in properties.
Understand the relationship between zinc (zinc alloys) and corrosion protection and be able to classify this for applications.
Know central requirements and properties of materials for semiconductor technology and be able to fundamentally transfer them to component requirements.
Understand mechanisms, influencing factors in piezo ceramics and shape memory alloys and be able to derive applications in sensor technology & actuators.

syllabus_topics: Steels & Cast Iron: Influence of alloying elements and heat treatments on properties, classification and designations, applications

Aluminum alloys: Influence of alloying elements, selection and differentiation of cast and wrought alloys and classification of additive manufacturing processes, resulting properties, possible heat treatments and applications
Zinc: Corrosion protection principles, influence of alloying elements in cast and wrought alloys, derivation of applications
Materials for semiconductor technology: Fundamentals, requirements and essential physical properties of semiconductors
Sensor technology and Actuator technology (Piezo ceramics & Shape Memory Alloys): Mechanisms, influencing factors and applications
assessment_rules: The assessment consists of a 90-minute written examination. Practical experiments on materials testing and characterization are conducted and documented by students. Practical reports are prepared for each experiment. These reports, depending on their quality, lead to bonus points, which are added to the examination performance. A maximum of 5% bonus points is possible relative to the points achievable in the examination.
